lines.zh: 我贴着地板爬，速度很快。
lines.en: I crawl low across the floor, fast.

lines.zh: 我四肢并用，一步跨很远。
lines.en: I use all four limbs and cover ground quickly.

lines.zh: 我从墙根窜到另一个墙根。
lines.en: I dart from one wall base to another.

lines.zh: 我身子低，影子几乎贴地。
lines.en: I keep low, my shadow almost flat on the ground.
I slip around the table legs, hugging close.
I crawl over the threshold without pausing.
One dash and I am at the corner.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在木头上留了痕。
lines.en: My claws leave marks in the wood.
I feel my way forward along the wall base.
I stay only half a block above the floor.
I swap hands step by step, fast.

lines.zh: 我从桌下钻过去，头也不抬。
lines.en: I slip under the table without lifting my head.

lines.zh: 我沿着台阶的边缘爬上来。
lines.en: I crawl up along the edge of the steps.

lines.zh: 我转了个弯，身子几乎贴着地。
lines.en: I turn a corner, my body almost on the ground.
One leap takes me onto the wall.
I crawl eagerly and cannot stop.
I hang on the wall without moving.
I am waiting for you to look up.

lines.zh: 我的头转到不该转的角度。
lines.en: My head is turned at a wrong angle.

lines.zh: 我的四肢太长，收不回去。
lines.en: My limbs are too long to draw in.
I fold into a small bundle in the corner.

lines.zh: 我用一条腿挠了挠耳朵。
lines.en: I scratch my ear with one leg.
I lie on the beam and look down.
My fingers tap against the wall.
I do not pant, yet my chest pulses.
I wait for you to pass underneath.
I stretch a leg out, then pull it back.

lines.zh: 我在天花板上一动不动。
lines.en: I hold still on the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我的关节反着弯，很自然。
lines.en: My joints bend backwards, naturally.
I chew on my own finger.

lines.zh: 我从墙缝里探出半个头。
lines.en: Half my head pokes out of a crack.
I shift slowly across the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你，角度很怪。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you at a strange angle.

lines.zh: 我的头转过来，身体还没转。
lines.en: My head turns before my body does.
I stare at you from the ceiling.
Your neck is very close to me.

lines.zh: 我吞了下口水，喉咙在动。
lines.en: I swallow, and my throat moves.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，我就缩回梁后。
lines.en: You look up and I pull back behind the beam.

lines.zh: 我的手指在你头顶上方张合。
lines.en: My fingers open and close above your head.

lines.zh: 你看我不太舒服，我知道。
lines.en: You are uneasy looking at me; I know.
I turn my face sideways so you can see.
Your height is just right for my leap.

lines.zh: 墙上的位置，正好看你头顶。
lines.en: From the wall, I see the top of your head.
I smile, and it does not fit.
The blow rolls me onto the floor.
My leg bends wrong, then rights itself.
I hiss, high and sharp.

lines.zh: 我顺着墙缝往上爬，躲开你。
lines.en: I climb the wall crack and slip out of reach.
I retreat into the corner and curl up.
One of my claws snaps off.
I fall off the wall.
I twitch once, then go still.

lines.zh: 你打得很准，可惜我很快。
lines.en: Your aim was good; a pity I am fast.
I crawl two steps away, crooked.

lines.zh: 你身上那股味，我闻到了。
lines.en: I caught that smell on you.
You are hurt, and I like it more.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我正好下来。
lines.en: You back against the wall, and I come down.

lines.zh: 你把灯放下，我就敢靠近。
lines.en: Set the lamp down and I dare come near.

lines.zh: 你在屋里走，我跟着墙走。
lines.en: You walk the room; I walk the walls.

lines.zh: 那里有动静，我朝那边爬。
lines.en: Something moves there, so I crawl that way.
Your breathing draws me on.

lines.zh: 你关上窗，我就不用绕了。
lines.en: Close the window and I need not go around.
Your footsteps are very regular.
You have a wound; let me lick it.

lines.zh: 你们躲在屋里，我不介意。
lines.en: You hide indoors, and I do not mind.
That door gap is exactly my size.

lines.zh: 你躲进死角，我手脚都痒。
lines.en: You back into a corner, and my limbs itch.
Living things always give off heat.

lines.zh: 你手里那点肉，我看到了。
lines.en: I see that bit of meat in your hand.
Lock the chest and I will pry it.
You bump me and I roll once.
I brush past your legs.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我抓住你的裤脚。
lines.en: We collide and I grab your trouser leg.
Knocked into the wall, I stick to it.
One touch and I shoot upward.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖顶到我，我歪了一下。
lines.en: Your knee hits me and I go crooked.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的小腿绕了一圈。
lines.en: I circle your calf, pressed close.
I'm small, but I climb walls.

lines.zh: 我推你一下，跑到你身后。
lines.en: I shove you once and dash behind you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我，我扭身就窜开。
lines.en: You step on me and I twist away.

lines.zh: 两只爬行者在墙上碰了一下。
lines.en: Two crawlers touch on the wall.
It comes crawling from the other wall.

lines.zh: 我从墙面下来，四爪抓得牢。
lines.en: I come down the wall on four gripping claws.
Our legs fold over one another.
They gather in the corner, crowded.
It and I exchange one look.
At moments like this we make no sound.
Two of us press together, silent.
We climb the same beam.
We head for the same window.
I snatch it up and push it into my mouth.
I pinch it up with my toes.
I climb the wall with it in my teeth.
Whatever falls, I taste first.
I pick it up and look; it is meat.
I tuck it into a crack in the wall.

lines.zh: 我一边爬一边把东西拖走。
lines.en: I drag it away while crawling.

lines.zh: 我抢在你的手之前捡到。
lines.en: I grab it before your hand gets there.
I crush it and juice runs between my fingers.
This is too small to fill me.
I see you, right down there.
I have my eye on you from above.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀在动，我记住了。
lines.en: Your shoulders move; I have noted it.
I chose you because you are slowest.

lines.zh: 我的头转过来，你就该跑了。
lines.en: When my head turns, you should run.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙往上爬，指甲抠进砖缝。
lines.en: I climb the wall, nails in the brick.

lines.zh: 我从天花板落下来，抓住你的背。
lines.en: I drop from the ceiling and take your back.

lines.zh: 目标就是那个还站着的。
lines.en: The target is the one still standing.
I flatten myself, ready to dart.
The wound on you is calling me.

lines.zh: 你在下面走，我在上面跟。
lines.en: You walk below; I follow above.

lines.zh: 我贴着天花板，一直看着你。
lines.en: I cling to the ceiling and keep watching.
You look up, and I move.

lines.zh: 我在梁上倒挂着，等你进门。
lines.en: I hang upside down from the beam, waiting.
I wait for you to come near a wall.
Shut the door; I come through the window gap.
I have not gone far.

lines.zh: 你的灯光照不到天花板。
lines.en: Your lamp does not reach the ceiling.
I move beam to beam.

lines.zh: 你越找，我在越高的地方。
lines.en: The more you search, the higher I go.
I drop from above onto your shoulders.
I bite your ear.

lines.zh: 我的爪子刮过你的脖子。
lines.en: My claws rake your neck.

lines.zh: 我攀住你的背，撕了一下。
lines.en: I cling to your back and tear.
I bite your hand.
I dart in from the side and claw you.

lines.zh: 这一下很快，你来不及挡。
lines.en: That was fast; you had no time to block.

lines.zh: 我扒住你的肩膀往下撕。
lines.en: I hook your shoulder and rip downward.

lines.zh: 我撞在你膝盖上，你就弯了。
lines.en: I hit your knee and it buckles.
I bite and climb the wall.

lines.zh: 砖缝够宽，我把自己挤进来。
lines.en: The brick gap is wide enough; I squeeze in.

lines.zh: 天花板上多了一条影子。
lines.en: A shape appears on the ceiling.
First a hand reaches out from under the table.
I flip in over the windowsill.

lines.zh: 夜里地板上爬过来一个东西。
lines.en: Something crawls across the floor at night.
I land and stick to the wall at once.
You hear claws first.

lines.zh: 我从门外爬进来，没有开门。
lines.en: I crawl in from outside without opening the door.
I lower myself from the beam.

lines.zh: 墙角多了个会动的东西。
lines.en: Something moving appears in the corner.
Fire burns me and I drop.

lines.zh: 我从梁上摔下，四脚朝天。
lines.en: I fall from the beam onto my back.
Water floods me and my legs thrash.
The blast peels me off the wall.
An arrow pins me to the door frame.

lines.zh: 法术一照，我的腿都不听使唤。
lines.en: A spell hits and my legs stop obeying.
Hungry too long, even my crawl slows.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身缩成一团。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I clench into a ball.

lines.zh: 虚空卷我进去，爪子抓空了。
lines.en: The void takes me and my claws close on nothing.
